customrecordtype.recordname: S4VP Tài khoản chi phí lương theo đích
customrecordtype.description: Payroll expense account by allocation target (project, class / work center or department), optionally per subsidiary, labor type and effective date. Priority when posting: class, project, department, employee profile account, default account. Acumatica screen VP102080. Generated by tools/gen_objects.mjs.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Công ty con
customrecordcustomfield.description: Empty = applies to every subsidiary. A row with a subsidiary overrides a shared row for the same target.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Empty = applies to every subsidiary. A row with a subsidiary overrides a shared row for the same target.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Loại đích
customrecordcustomfield.description: P = project, W = class (work center), D = department. Fill the matching target field below.
customrecordcustomfield.help: P = project, W = class (work center), D = department. Fill the matching target field below.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Dự án
customrecordcustomfield.description: Required when the target type is P.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Required when the target type is P.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Class (work center)
customrecordcustomfield.description: Required when the target type is W.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Required when the target type is W.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Phòng ban
customrecordcustomfield.description: Required when the target type is D.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Required when the target type is D.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Loại lao động
customrecordcustomfield.description: Empty = both employees and contractors. A row with a labor type is used before a row without one.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Empty = both employees and contractors. A row with a labor type is used before a row without one.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Hiệu lực từ ngày
customrecordcustomfield.description: Empty = always effective. The latest row effective on or before the pay period end date is used.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Empty = always effective. The latest row effective on or before the pay period end date is used.
